caption: Repetitive admin drains time and slow decisions. This carousel turns a weak, manual approach into a repeatable, AI-assisted workflow. Five prompts move you from diagnosing waste to building a reusable playbook. Which admin task will you automate first? #AIforBiz #Productivity #Automation

slides.title: Stop Repeating Admin Work
slides.body: Repetitive admin drains time; I will show a better workflow with five practical prompts.

slides.title: 1. Benefit
slides.body: Task: diagnose admin tasks. Placeholder: [LAST_WEEK_TASK_LIST]. Output: a bullet list of top 5 time sinks with impact.

slides.title: 2. Benefit
slides.body: Task: create a single standardized email/task template for repetitive messages. Placeholder: [TEMPLATE_FIELDS]. Output: a ready-to-copy template and fill-in prompts.

slides.title: 3. Benefit
slides.body: Task: propose 3 automation steps using [TOOL] to push templates into tasks. Output: a list of triggers, actions, and checks.

slides.title: 4. Benefit
slides.body: Task: verify a generated memo or email draft for accuracy and tone. Placeholder: [DRAFT]. Output: revised draft with flagged issues.

slides.title: 5. Benefit
slides.body: Task: compile a 1-page admin playbook with a checklist and success metrics. Placeholder: [CHECKLIST_ITEMS]. Output: final checklist plus KPI examples.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Use the playbook to cut admin time by 40% and improve output quality.
